intuition: The next available seat is always the smallest available number.

brute_force.approach: Scan every seat from one to n for each reservation.

optimal.approach: Use a min-heap for returned seats and a pointer for seats never reserved before.
optimal.time: reserve O(log n), unreserve O(log n)

edge_cases: Returned seats must be chosen before untouched higher seat numbers.
The manager never reserves a seat twice concurrently.
